stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"On a company's page, the filter 'במה הכסף מושקע' is useless: each of its choices holds a single track.","where":"the filter chips above the tracks list","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Can't tell which Harel product (pension, קרן השתלמות or קופת גמל להשקעה) their savings are in
The '123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנתה' line is confusing (why '123' three times in different colours)
Product names like 'תגמולים ואישית לפיציויים' and 'קרן חדשה כללית' mean nothing; unclear what makes a pension מקיפה or כללית
Doesn't know what 'קופת גמל להשקעה' actually is
The 'במה הכסף מושקע' buttons are too many and most names aren't understood
Footnote says direct expenses aren't shown, which is worrying: the fee isn't the whole cost
'PF-10' in the footnote means nothing
The past-returns warning (returns before fees and tax) makes the returns feel less trustworthy
The fee column doesn't help choose: all fees are 0.54–0.61% and the deposit fee is 0% everywhere
The 'קופה' number column (15283, 13414) is unclear; doesn't know why to click its link icon
Doesn't understand 'מט"ח' or the teal/yellow colours and ring drawings in the exposure column
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no return, so they can't be compared
Unclear what the difference is between the 'מההיסכון' and 'מההפקדה' fees
Doesn't understand the jargon אג"ח, סחיר, גמיש, כספי (שקלי), קיימות
Unclear why the 'מניות' track is 94% stocks and how it differs from 'עוקב מדד מניות'
Unclear whether 'ממוצע 2025' is what they would pay or what people paid on average
Can't find what they're personally paying now or whether they could get a lower fee
Can't find returns after fees and tax
Can't find whether or how they can switch tracks, and whether it costs anything or affects tax
No comparison with other companies' S&P 500 tracks on this page
Would drop the 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל' section first
Would drop the closed sections (קרנות מחקות, מרכזיות לפיצויים, קרנות סל)
Would drop the 'לא מצאתם שם?' search box

problems.why: The reader complains that the 'במה הכסף מושקע' chips are too many and hard to understand, but never says that each chip holds only one track and so the filter is useless.
